name: Resumalyze — tailor résumés to jobs, in 1 click
description: Spots a job posting you're reading and tailors your résumé and cover letter to it in one click.

tailor-current.description: Tailor my résumé for the job on this page

content_scripts.//: Injected broadly BECAUSE Chrome match patterns cannot wildcard a top-level domain. These boards run dozens of country domains each (ziprecruiter.ie, ie.whatjobs.com, de.indeed.com, seek.co.nz) and every one we failed to list was a silent failure. content.js decides for itself whether a page is a job posting and stands down immediately otherwise — see the start-up block at the bottom of that file.
The token handshake. It must run on the DEPLOYED app, or pressing Connect opens resumalyze.com and nothing there ever answers.
